metadata.title: Compact metric spaces as exponentiable metric compact Hausdorff spaces
metadata.abstract: The class of compact metric spaces (metric spaces which induce a compact topology), despite being an important class of metric spaces, is not closed under many natural constructions. For instance, infinite metric products of compact metric spaces will often fail to induce a compact topology, while on the other hand, the topological product of any family of compact metric spaces is always a compact topological space, evidencing a discrepancy between topological and metric products. The notion of metric compact Hausdorff space -- compact Hausdorff spaces equipped with a lower semi-continuous metric -- provides a class of spaces which keep track of metric data and topological data separately, thereby forming a complete and cocomplete category, while including all compact metric spaces. Our main contribution is that this inclusion can be characterised via universal property: the compact metric spaces are the exponentiable metric compact Hausdorff spaces with respect to a natural monoidal structure on the respective category.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 紧度量空间的可指数对象刻画
analysis.workSummary: 在紧Hausdorff拓扑配下半连续度量的范畴中，保留拓扑和度量两套数据以获得完备余完备范畴。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明普通紧度量空间恰是该范畴中相应单体结构下可指数对象，给其嵌入的范畴刻画。
analysis.limitations: 需区分度量诱导的紧拓扑与独立指定的紧Hausdorff拓扑，结论依赖所选单体结构。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。完整15页文本及点写AI、拆行/连字符模型名型号、Danus、HyProver/Hunyuan等补检未见作者使用生成式AI的声明，亦未见相关候选。此判断只限本版本中未观察到披露，不表示作者实际未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 范畴化度量拓扑基础，与比较几何联系间接。
